distance_interpretation: a SUPPORTED_BEFORE hit whose earliest record predates the clearance by more than three years is a keyword+affiliation match decades old, NOT programme-level corroboration; only NEAR hits may be read that way, and even then a human must confirm relevance

interpretation.SUPPORTED_BEFORE: an independent, dated publication precedes the clearance
interpretation.NO_RECORD: the query returned nothing usable; this is a null search, not evidence of absence
interpretation.AMBIGUOUS: records exist but none is independent or dated
interpretation.AFTER_CLEARANCE: records exist but none precedes the clearance
interpretation.NOT_EVALUABLE: no clearance date or no track keywords

not_claimed: no label: every packet remains PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW with final_label null
no predictive claim: a paper before a clearance is compatible with routine incremental work
no aggregate claim across nine events, three firms, and a post-hoc keyword crosswalk
NO_RECORD is not evidence that no research existed
